mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARKING_REALTIME (prk_center_id, pkfc_parking_lots_total, pkfc_available_parking_lots_total) VALUES (#{prkCenterId}, #{pkfcParkingLotsTotal}, #{pkfcAvailableParkingLotsTotal})
mapper.update: UPDATE PARKING_REALTIME SET pkfc_parking_lots_total = #{pkfcParkingLotsTotal}, pkfc_available_parking_lots_total = #{pkfcAvailableParkingLotsTotal}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE prk_center_id = #{prkCenterId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARKING_REALTIME (prk_center_id, pkfc_parking_lots_total, pkfc_available_parking_lots_total) VALUES (#{prkCenterId}, #{pkfcParkingLotsTotal}, #{pkfcAvailableParkingLotsTotal}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pkfc_parking_lots_total = VALUES(pkfc_parking_lots_total), pkfc_available_parking_lots_total = VALUES(pkfc_available_parking_lots_total), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PARKING_REALTIME WHERE (pkfc_parking_lots_total - pkfc_available_parking_lots_total) / pkfc_parking_lots_total >= #{occupancyRate}
